name: @sos-2/search
description: SOS 2.0 Candidate Search (Work Order W7; requirements R11, R12, R28, R29): the swappable CandidateSearchEngine contract with the reasoning-altitude ladder (validated composition -> validated package -> package adaptation -> architecture pattern -> novel architecture -> low-level synthesis — descend only with recorded justification), typed hard constraints filtering candidates BEFORE evaluation, and an EXPLICIT typed exploration/exploitation policy (greedy / epsilon-greedy / UCB-shaped bandit over the diverse candidate set with uncertainty from applicability estimates).
